market_context: Markets are sliding following a hotter-than-expected October CPI report (0.4% MoM vs. 0.3% expected), which spiked the 10-year Treasury yield above 5.02% and reignited expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Hawkish remarks from Fed officials and renewed risk-off sentiment have pushed major indexes to session lows at midday, with tech and high-beta assets suffering the steepest losses.

predictions.reasoning: Tech equities are bearing the brunt of the macro shock after October core CPI rose 0.3%, driving the 10-year yield to 5.02%. Hawkish commentary from Dallas Fed President Logan calling for further rate hikes leaves growth valuations vulnerable, with QQQ pinned at session lows into midday.

Broad market sentiment has deteriorated as rising borrowing costs and stubborn inflation overshadow Monday's relief rally. With SPY hitting its intraday trough of $745.13 at midday and the VIX jumping above 20.7, afternoon institutional repositioning is expected to lean defensive.

Nvidia faces compounding pressure from both the macro yield spike and company-specific overhang from an ongoing board investigation. Down nearly 7% today and resting at session lows, buyers remain sidelined, pointing to further softness into the 4:00 PM close.

Crypto assets are declining alongside risk assets as surging bond yields and rising rate hike odds drain speculative liquidity. BTC-USD is hovering near its daily floor around $72760, and equity market de-risking into the close should exert continued downward pressure.
